entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider utilizing a custom vector graph engine and hybrid search. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and supports connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It employs L0/L1/L2 tiered loading to reduce token spend and provides observable retrieval via directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges. It provides synthesized answers including gap analysis and supports scoped data access for team environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and offers Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports Python and TypeScript client SDKs. It provides a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted use and offers hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates playbooks, hints, and datasets from runs. It supports Python and TypeScript/Node CLI and libraries and provides MCP server functionality.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based context engine to prevent message loss. It utilizes a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides portable identity, memory, and secrets for agents including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It automates memory creation from imported files and transcripts, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It supports Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code while providing zero-cost local-first search.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search and integrates through MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of embeddings or vector databases. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every retrieval. It features contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and a self-directing loop for knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server utilizing local-first SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support to create bidirectional relationships via edge tags.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only the necessary context. It supports stdio and SSE MCP servers and renders context to assistant-specific files.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A daemonless, long-term memory solution that stores information as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings from keyword selection.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage agent memory with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory solution, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate event deletion to ensure removed data does not persist in future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session AI memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering tools for searching, remembering, and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to manage financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It facilitates an autonomous payment model where APIs can charge for services and agents can pay for them directly.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with support for manual storage and search. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports execution via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods with MinHash deduplication for robust data management.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing and artifact management through five native tools and a proactive router skill. It includes an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation to streamline agent integration.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Featuring 17 tools for memory management, this provider utilizes a hybrid search strategy combining BM25, vector, and graph methods. It automatically performs context checkpointing during message compression to maintain knowledge graph integrity.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin provides private semantic and literal search capabilities specifically for code repositories. It enables grounded Q&A with precise file-and-line citations while running entirely on localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a software development methodology utilizing subagent-driven development for engineering tasks. It emphasizes TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles while supporting harnesses such as Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It includes an MCP server for integration with coding agents and uses DESIGN.md for brand system definitions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement to unify skills across agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills that preserve state in a docs/ folder. These are available as spec-conformant Agent Plugins compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill provides adjudication for agent-to-agent deals, including escrow and dispute resolution. It connects fragmented ecosystem layers using natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection includes 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides access to YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists. It is powered by TranscriptAPI and is compatible with the Agent Skills format.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots to improve reasoning quality.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It provides structured memory via file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This repository provides specialized skills for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specific skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard for Hermes Agent users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides prompting guides for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models along with API integration documentation. It includes a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool extracts function signatures and types from code and documentation to create agentskills.io-compliant skills. It produces version-pinned skills that include an audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language for AI uses a single Rust binary to provide intent as code through four verbs. It enables local-first execution with any LLM and provides static auditing via nika check alongside tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon architecture to maintain persistent connections and allows for incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a 5-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It features a deterministic pre-scan layer and an MCP server that generates suppression rules to reduce false positives.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation by implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face and operates autonomously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures to implement multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness to simplify code. It employs a risk-tiered triage system for modifications and includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides 2,077 total skills and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and OWASP.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC through protocols such as Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Provides functional quality certification for AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker environments. The system produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for verification.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: Generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. The tool produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions, utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Offers a suite of tools including video-to-text for local or Douyin links, document OCR for scans and PDFs, and an e-commerce material studio. These skills are compatible with the agentskills.io open standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This repository provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This project provides scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository offers an automated Termux-based installer for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama as well as compatibility with OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables Kubernetes deployment with cloud-native state-safety guardrails to enforce single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and configurable gateway mode.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. The setup integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and features configurable security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and costs via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces through a single web application. It offers enterprise MCP access and supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and task scheduling.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This production package, distributed via GitHub Releases, allows Hermes to run as a TUI, Desktop app, or Gateway. It includes bundled CPython 3.12 and PortableGit and supports side-by-side execution with an existing Hermes installation.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes and other coding agents. It runs entirely locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux, featuring an auto-sync capability to keep the index current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and visualization dashboard that tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents including Hermes and Claude Code. It monitors local data files to provide detailed analytics on consumption patterns.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other clients like Cursor or Gemini. It offers a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and automatically redacts authentication headers to ensure security during inspection.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, supporting any AI provider that uses markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This utility provides a real-time widget for tracking tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It features customizable dashboard modules and supports data synchronization across multiple devices.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins offers community-created themes and CLI skins to customize the terminal UI of Hermes Agent. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art through YAML-based configurations, with options ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports various providers like Anthropic and OpenAI while offering an undo functionality for recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This repository provides integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph, alongside editor tooling for VS Code and messaging platforms. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code designed to capture prompts and tool traces.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations, skills, and memories. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services to get a system running in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It analyzes various file formats to detect issues such as conflicting directives or missing limits using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats. It handles the migration of SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives, including the setup of systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides fully local, offline functionality with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, serves as an all-in-one controller for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users to manage multiple agentic tools simultaneously.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent and other CLIs into a single interface accessible via WebUI or messaging platforms like Telegram and WeChat. The app includes 21 built-in professional assistants to supplement its multi-agent support.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this tool enables access to Hermes Agent through a web browser or SSH tunnel. It features a workspace file browser with inline previews, optimized for use on both desktop and mobile devices.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the Hermes Agent experience by providing guided installation and provider configuration. It offers a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one location.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This comprehensive web dashboard manages Hermes Agent through desktop, npm, or Docker distributions while supporting 10 platform channels including Slack and WhatsApp. It features visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and detailed usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated MCP catalog for managing agent skills and memory.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other CLI agents into a self-hosted or desktop application. It supports task delegation to sub-agents and provides native mobile clients for both iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application, built with Tauri and Rust, includes a built-in runtime for local kernel management. The interface supports LaTeX rendering and provides dedicated modules for chat, MCP tools, and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to local or remote Hermes gateways. It features site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments and a full-page session management interface called Hermes Web Alpha.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from their iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser and agent cockpit. It offers searchable history for ten supported agent sources and live per-session quota burn tracking with local-only data processing.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace is designed for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation for fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests with side effects.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop version of Hermes Agent that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A configuration dashboard used for process monitoring and session activity tracking. It allows for real-time cost tracking and read-only inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
